title: Named ordinary integral quotient maps and balancing isomorphisms
statement: Fix the completed coefficient sheaf and finite quotient levels on W [lem-coef-compact-support-quotient-coordinates]. The specified ordinary integral adjunction, with its normalized unit, gives a natural quotient transformation alpha:L_m -> Res_mn L_n. The canonical composition of ordinary left adjoints gives an isomorphism beta:Lq L_m -> L_n. Their sections satisfy alpha(s tensor x)=q(s) tensor x and beta(t tensor(s tensor x))=(t q(s)) tensor x. The quotient formula uses HEq between the canonically identical restricted section carrier and the ordinary level-n carrier. All constructions use the actual completed projections and quotient maps; there is no existence-only data choice.

proof.text: Use the already normalized ordinary integral adjunctions, the actual projection composition equality and the generic natural quotient transformation to construct alpha. Use the canonical left-adjoint composition isomorphism to construct beta. The generic component formulas specialize to these named maps; the unit tensor convention is exactly the one in the coordinate module.
